partnerships.name: tell.money
partnerships.title: Seapoint uses tell.money for its Open Banking dedicated interface
partnerships.desription: Seapoint partners with tell.money to provide open banking APIs so regulated third-party providers can access Seapoint business accounts with the customer's consent.

apiProducts.label: Account Information (EU)
apiProducts.description: NextGenPSD2 (Berlin Group) account information API for Seapoint EUR business accounts: accounts, balances and transactions. Third-party providers reach Seapoint business accounts through Tell Money's dedicated interface. E-money services provided by Modulr Finance B.V. (De Nederlandsche Bank, R182870).
